title: Interface Naming & Range
description: Learn how Cisco names interfaces and how to configure multiple ports at once with interface range.
scenario: Check how the switch names its ports with show interfaces status, open FastEthernet0/1 in interface configuration mode, then select ports 1 to 4 together with interface range.

objectives.text: See how the switch names its ports (Fa0/1 = FastEthernet0/1)
Exit back to global configuration mode
Select ports 1 to 4 together with interface range

concepts.title: Interface Naming
concepts.body: Cisco interfaces are named by type, module, and port. Examples: FastEthernet0/1, GigabitEthernet0/1, VLAN1. You can type the short form (Fa0/1) too.
concepts.code:
FastEthernet0/1 → Fa0/1
GigabitEthernet0/1 → Gi0/1
VLAN 1 → Vlan1

concepts.title: Interface Range
concepts.body: Use "interface range" to configure multiple ports at once. Saves time on access ports or shutdown commands. The prompt becomes (config-if-range)#.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/1 - 4
SW1(config-if-range)# switchport mode access

concepts.title: Verifying Interfaces
concepts.body: "show interfaces status" gives a quick overview. "show interfaces" gives detailed info per port.
concepts.code:
SW1# show interfaces status
Port   Status   Vlan   Duplex  Speed
Fa0/1  connected 1     a-full  a-100
